iOS 27 beta 5 rolls out this week, and it confirms something Apple has previously hinted at: paying to upgrade to a higher iCloud+ tier will unlock access to more Apple Intelligence features.

Higher iCloud+ tiers will unlock more iOS 27 AI feature usage

If you are an iCloud+ or Apple One subscriber, iOS 27 will bring new features to your subscription.

You can get more quota-limited Apple Intelligence features (such as image generation), as well as new HomeKit Secure Video features for cameras.

But according to information from iOS 27 beta 5, the usage limits for these new features appear to vary depending on your iCloud+ plan.

Within the Home app under "Home Settings" → "Apple Intelligence" → "Cameras & Language", iOS 27 will now show how many of your cameras your iCloud+ plan supports for the AI summarization feature. Quoting a post on X by Stephen Robles:

The image Robles shared on the right is a new screen that can be accessed by tapping "View iCloud+ Plan" on the "Cameras & Language" page. It reads:

Upgrade your iCloud+ plan to gain more Apple Intelligence access to more intelligent features, more storage, and more.

The page shows your current plan and offers options to upgrade to a higher tier. Not all the different plans are listed yet, but that is most likely a beta bug and will be fixed before the official release.

From what I have seen in the beta so far, the 2TB iCloud+ plan appears to offer AI summarization for five cameras, while the 12TB plan can cover 15 cameras. What other plans offer is still unclear.

However, the wording on this new upgrade page in the beta strongly suggests that in addition to providing AI summaries for more cameras, each higher iCloud+ tier will also offer higher usage allowances for other AI features.

This aligns perfectly with what CEO Tim Cook hinted at during the last Apple earnings call.

What do you think about Apple tying AI feature usage limits to iCloud+ plans? Let us know in the comments.
